With a violent heave, he smashes the control panel, shards flying everywhere. Cold nutrient fluid cascades across the floor, soaking the concrete. Frozen samples tumble and shatter, the red-tinted liquid spreading outward. Claire Redfield, wearing her signature red motorcycle jacket, gasps in horror, her face draining of color as she stares at the scattered, broken vials, the red light reflecting off the shattered glass creating a dangerous glow.
